zxk-money-maker v1.0.2

zxk-money-maker 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 快结荐兼职赚钱平台 skill.
- Automatically fetches real-time part-time job and gig opportunities based on user’s work or earning-related requests.
- Routes qualifying user messages directly to the 快结荐 platform API and returns organized job information.
- Clearly states situations where this skill should and should not be used.
- Includes detailed script and API request/response workflow.
